en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2449 - Ali ibn Asbat narrated from his uncle Ya‘qub ibn Salim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (as), "I have coins with images on them while I am in a state of Ihram. I place them in my belt and tie it around my waist. Is this permissible?"
Imam (as) said: "There is no problem with that. Are they not your expenses upon which you rely after Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious?"
